qualification.scope: Actual default resolver bootstrap only; no full cold host, native session or fresh OS claim.

boundaries: Preinstalled patched Node 22.23.3, compatible OS dependencies and user 1000 exist in the disposable Linux image. No fresh OS installation or OS dependency automation is qualified.
The fixture supplies a new private HOME and TMPDIR on an explicitly provisioned 2 GiB tmpfs. The normal Playwright user cache initially lacks the binary.

Only the actual installed ensureBrowser default resolver runs, using shipped sanitized hostEnv and its real bundled installer. No custom bundle, spawn implementation, executable path or cache variable is supplied.
The 3 observed installer child PID/start identities are positively gone. The separate synchronous Chromium --version child exited zero.
Raw noBrowserLaunch means no browser session or context was launched; the browser executable was invoked for --version.
The second default resolver call reuses the cache and produces no second install log.
This does not qualify the full cold host/session readiness latency, enrollment, unlocked Secret Service provisioning, native UI or final HOAI profile composition.
Later automatic backup timer fixes may supersede the common implementation; this exact historical bootstrap source and package/image receipt remain independently pinned.
